note.title: Accuracy traps
note.overview: This lesson contains 50 enabled questions. It teaches Accuracy traps through explicit translation, recall, grammar and application tasks.
learningGoals: Recall the core language for Accuracy traps.
Identify the task direction before writing.
Explain errors by naming the article, subject, tense, auxiliary, agreement or negative rule.
Use the material in a short controlled sentence.
mustMemoriseRules: Correct the grammar job, not only the visible spelling.
Check opinion articles and negative articles separately.
Every passé composé verb needs the right auxiliary.
Être participles may agree with the subject.
Irregular participles must be recalled exactly.

workedExamples.why: After opinions, use the definite article.

workedExamples.prompt: Correct this: Je ne bois pas du coca.
workedExamples.answer: Je ne bois pas de coca.
workedExamples.why: After ne…pas, change to de / d’.

workedExamples.prompt: Correct this: J’ai allé au cinéma.

commonMistakes: Correcting only one word instead of rewriting the sentence.
Fixing spelling while leaving the grammar error.
A small article or ending can change the grammar even when the main vocabulary is recognisable.

Do not tick the checklist without checking the actual form.
